title: Plan AK: AI WeChat & Weibo Content
summary: Topic → long / short posts → images → multi-platform adaptation → engagement review
scenario: For individuals or teams running both a WeChat Official Account and Weibo — one theme, two placements.

steps.title: Topic selection
steps.detail: Combine trends, account positioning and reader questions into a topic list, scored by 'what pain does the audience feel and why care'. Deep topics for WeChat, light topics for Weibo.
steps.tips: Bank ten topics at once so publishing never stalls; refresh with new trends weekly.

steps.title: Long / short posts
steps.detail: WeChat long-form follows 'hook → argument → examples → conclusion'; build the skeleton before filling prose. Distill quotes and angles from the long-form for Weibo, keeping posts under ~140 characters.
steps.tips: Let the model draft to ~70% for long-form; add your own views and cases to avoid the AI flavor.

steps.title: Images
steps.detail: Build the WeChat cover with a Canva template and generate in-body art with Midjourney on demand. Keep the cover style consistent so the column is recognizable.
steps.tips: Lock one cover layout (title + colors + graphic) so readers spot your account instantly.

steps.title: Multi-platform adaptation
steps.detail: Publish long-form on WeChat and split into 2-3 short Weibo posts with hashtags — different framing and pacing per platform. Check layout, links and mentions on both.
steps.tips: Lead Weibo with the conclusion and put the fuller story in replies — it lifts shares and comments.

steps.title: Engagement review
steps.detail: After posting, collect reads, shares, comments and saves; have the model compare which topics and styles performed. Save winning patterns as templates for reuse.
steps.tips: Review weekly and track just three metrics: open rate, completion rate, and shares/comments.

pitfalls.title: Posting the same text everywhere
pitfalls.detail: A WeChat long-form dumped on Weibo gets ignored; rewrite for each platform's context.

pitfalls.title: Ignoring comments
pitfalls.detail: Comments are your best topic mine; reserve 30 minutes after posting to reply.

pitfalls.title: Cover that lies
pitfalls.detail: Clickbait covers burn trust once; make the cover deliver what it promises.

pitfalls.title: Not banking methodology
pitfalls.detail: Starting from scratch every issue means no compounding; turn reviews into a template library.
